facts.text: Under UMass Amherst Advantage, Massachusetts residents with a household adjusted gross income of $75,000 or less pay no cost for tuition and mandatory fees.

sources.title: Amherst Advantage : UMass Amherst
sources.quote: Beginning with the Fall 2025 semester, if your household earns an adjusted gross income of $75,000 or less, you can qualify to attend UMass Amherst at no cost for tuition and mandatory fees.
